title: Sound Basket
shareTitle: Sound Basket 🧺 — Listen for First Sounds
description: Tap to hear each picture word, listen for its first sound, then drag matching pictures into a bright woven basket.
learningGoals: Isolate the first sound in a spoken word
Connect initial sounds to familiar letter baskets
Build phonemic awareness with picture-first play
interactionModel: tap-to-hear picture naming followed by forgiving drag-to-basket sorting with one spoken target sound per round
feedbackModel: Every card speaks its recorded word; matches fly into the basket with layered toy feedback, while distractors wiggle gently and remain available.

modes.title: Two Sounds
modes.skill: initial-sound isolation with two randomized contrasting onsets

modes.title: Three Sounds
modes.skill: initial-sound isolation across three randomized contrasting onsets
